title: The Art of Computer Programming, Volume 3: Sorting and Searching (Section 6.4 Hashing)
venue: Addison-Wesley, 2nd ed., ISBN 978-0-201-89685-5
algorithms_covered: Linear probing; quadratic probing; double hashing; separate chaining; hash function design
methodology: Combinatorial and probabilistic analysis of probe counts as functions of load factor alpha
key_findings_and_limitations: Canonical rigorous treatment of hashing; derives closed-form expected probe formulas; does not cover modern cache-line effects; MIX assembly examples dated.

title: Introduction to Algorithms (4th ed., Chapter 11: Hash Tables)
authors: Thomas H. Cormen; Charles E. Leiserson; Ronald L. Rivest; Clifford Stein
venue: MIT Press, ISBN 978-0-262-04630-5
algorithms_covered: Direct-address tables; separate chaining; universal hashing; open addressing (linear/quadratic/double hashing)
methodology: Pedagogical asymptotic analysis; pseudocode
key_findings_and_limitations: Updated 4th ed. emphasises linear probing for cache locality; covers universal hashing; no empirical benchmarks.

title: Robin Hood Hashing (PhD Thesis, CS-86-14)
venue: University of Waterloo Department of Computer Science Technical Report CS-86-14
algorithms_covered: Robin Hood open addressing; variance reduction; backward-shift deletion
methodology: Mathematical analysis of probe-sequence-length variance; comparison with standard open addressing
key_findings_and_limitations: First complete treatment of Robin Hood hashing; proves variance of PSL is O(log log n); limited empirical validation.

title: Robin Hood Hashing (Preliminary Report)
authors: Pedro Celis; Per-Åke Larson; J. Ian Munro
venue: Proceedings of the 26th Annual Symposium on Foundations of Computer Science (FOCS 1985), pp. 281–288
algorithms_covered: Robin Hood hashing; open addressing
methodology: Theoretical worst-case and average-case analysis
key_findings_and_limitations: Conference precursor to Celis 1986 thesis; establishes key proofs; labeled 'preliminary report'.

title: Reducing the Retrieval Time of Scatter Storage Techniques
venue: Communications of the ACM, Vol. 16, No. 2, pp. 105–109
algorithms_covered: Brent's Algorithm (open-addressing insertion optimisation)
methodology: Probability theory and Monte Carlo simulation
key_findings_and_limitations: Shows shifting existing elements at insertion reduces average lookup probes; trade-off is more expensive inserts; seminal for probe-count optimisation.

title: Universal Classes of Hash Functions
authors: J. Lawrence Carter; Mark N. Wegman
venue: Journal of Computer and System Sciences, Vol. 18, No. 2, pp. 143–154
algorithms_covered: Universal hashing; randomised hash families
methodology: Theoretical construction of hash function families; probabilistic collision analysis
key_findings_and_limitations: Foundational paper for universal hashing; proves expected O(1) operations independent of input; practical constructions using modular arithmetic.

title: Cuckoo Hashing
venue: Journal of Algorithms, Vol. 51, No. 2, pp. 122–144
algorithms_covered: Cuckoo hashing; worst-case O(1) lookup
methodology: Theoretical analysis and experimental comparison
key_findings_and_limitations: Guarantees worst-case O(1) lookup by using two hash functions and two tables; insertion O(1) amortised expected; space usage ~50%.

title: Linear Probing with Constant Independence
authors: Anna Pagh; Rasmus Pagh; Milan Ružić
venue: Proceedings of the 39th Annual ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC '07), pp. 318–327
algorithms_covered: Linear probing; hash independence requirements
methodology: Theoretical proof under limited randomness assumptions
key_findings_and_limitations: Shows 5-independent hash functions suffice for linear probing to achieve O(1) expected time; full journal version SIAM J. Comput. 39(3):1107–1120 (2009) DOI 10.1137/070702278.

title: A Seven-Dimensional Analysis of Hashing Methods and its Implications on Query Processing
authors: Stefan Richter; Victor Alvarez; Jens Dittrich
venue: Proceedings of the VLDB Endowment (PVLDB), Vol. 9, No. 3
algorithms_covered: Linear probing; chaining; Robin Hood hashing; cuckoo hashing; five hash function families
methodology: Empirical benchmarking across 7 dimensions: data distribution, load factor, dataset size, read/write ratio, success ratio, scheme, hash function
key_findings_and_limitations: Key finding: no single scheme dominates; Robin Hood hashing best at high load; SIMD-accelerated scanning crucial; practitioners must treat hash tables as white boxes.

title: Probability and Computing: Randomized Algorithms and Probabilistic Analysis (2nd ed.)
venue: Cambridge University Press, ISBN 978-1-107-15488-9
algorithms_covered: Universal hashing; balls-and-bins; chaining; perfect hashing; cuckoo hashing; Bloom filters
methodology: Mathematical probabilistic analysis; tail bounds; moment generating functions
key_findings_and_limitations: Standard graduate text; covers load factor analysis, pairwise independence, cuckoo hashing; heavy on proofs, light on implementation.

title: Algorithms (4th ed., Section 3.4: Hash Tables)
venue: Addison-Wesley Professional, ISBN 978-0-321-57351-3
algorithms_covered: Separate chaining; linear probing
methodology: Pedagogical Java implementations with empirical notes
key_findings_and_limitations: Accessible treatment; covers resizing strategies; Java-specific; no asymptotic proofs.

title: High Speed Hashing for Integers and Strings
venue: arXiv:1504.06804 [cs.DS] (updated 2020)
algorithms_covered: Multiply-shift; multiply-mod-prime; tabulation hashing; string hashing; k-independence
methodology: Survey and theoretical analysis bridging theory and practice
key_findings_and_limitations: Shows theoretically optimal functions are faster than textbook functions; tabulation hashing achieves strong universality at word-operation speed.

title: Dynamic Space-Efficient Hashing
authors: Tobias Maier; Peter Sanders; Stefan Walzer
venue: Algorithmica, Vol. 81, No. 8, pp. 3162–3185
algorithms_covered: Dynamic open-addressing hash tables; space-efficient resizing
methodology: Theoretical amortised analysis; experimental evaluation on modern hardware
key_findings_and_limitations: Achieves near-optimal space while maintaining O(1) amortised operations; useful for memory-constrained systems.

title: Dynamic Hash Tables
venue: Communications of the ACM, Vol. 31, No. 4, pp. 446–457
algorithms_covered: Linear hashing; dynamic resizing; extendible hashing
methodology: Analytical and empirical study
key_findings_and_limitations: Classic paper on gradual table expansion without full rehash; predecessor to modern incremental resizing strategies.

title: External Memory Algorithms and Data Structures: Dealing with Massive Data
venue: ACM Computing Surveys, Vol. 33, No. 2, pp. 209–271
algorithms_covered: Extendible hashing; linear hashing; B-trees; external memory dictionaries
methodology: I/O complexity analysis in Aggarwal-Vitter EM model
key_findings_and_limitations: Establishes I/O complexity bounds for external hash tables; shows trade-offs between hash tables and B-trees for range queries.

title: Cache-Oblivious Algorithms
authors: Matteo Frigo; Charles E. Leiserson; Harald Prokop; Sridhar Ramachandran
venue: Proceedings of the 40th Annual Symposium on Foundations of Computer Science (FOCS 1999), pp. 285–297
algorithms_covered: Cache-oblivious data layout; ideal-cache model; universal hashing as proof tool
methodology: Theoretical ideal-cache model; simulation arguments
key_findings_and_limitations: Introduces cache-oblivious paradigm; universal hashing used in proofs; not directly about hash tables but foundational for memory-hierarchy analysis.

title: Designing a Fast, Efficient, Cache-Friendly Hash Table, Step by Step (CppCon 2017 talk)
venue: CppCon 2017, Bellevue, WA. (Conference presentation)
algorithms_covered: SwissTable; SIMD group probing; control bytes; H1/H2 hash splitting; open addressing
methodology: Design walkthrough with benchmarks against std::unordered_map
key_findings_and_limitations: First public disclosure of SwissTable design; demonstrates up to 2× speedup over std::unordered_map; not peer-reviewed.

title: hashbrown: A Rust Port of Google's SwissTable Hash Map
venue: GitHub repository rust-lang/hashbrown (crate v0.1.0, 2018; adopted into Rust std since 1.36)
algorithms_covered: SwissTable (Rust port); SIMD probe; Robin Hood-inspired displacement
methodology: Open-source reference implementation with inline documentation
key_findings_and_limitations: Production-quality SwissTable port; adopted as Rust std HashMap backend; no formal peer-reviewed paper.

title: The Fowler/Noll/Vo (FNV) Non-Cryptographic Hash Algorithm (IETF Internet-Draft draft-eastlake-fnv-21)
authors: Glenn Fowler; Landon Curt Noll; Kiem-Phong Vo; Donald Eastlake; Tony Hansen
venue: IETF Internet-Draft (Informational)
algorithms_covered: FNV-1; FNV-1a; FNV-0 (deprecated); multi-width variants (32/64/128/256/512/1024-bit)
methodology: Specification with test vectors
key_findings_and_limitations: Specifies FNV-1a as preferred variant (XOR-then-multiply); not standardised (expired draft); widely used in practice.

title: New Hash Functions and Their Use in Authentication and Set Equality
authors: Mark N. Wegman; J. Lawrence Carter
venue: Journal of Computer and System Sciences, Vol. 22, No. 3, pp. 265–279
algorithms_covered: Strongly universal hashing; k-independent hash families; authentication codes
methodology: Algebraic construction and information-theoretic security proofs
key_findings_and_limitations: Extends Carter-Wegman 1979 to k-independence; foundational for security-conscious hashing and randomised data structures.

title: Notes on Open Addressing (Unpublished memorandum)
venue: Unpublished, July 22, 1963 — widely cited as origin of open addressing analysis
algorithms_covered: Linear probing; open addressing theory
methodology: Mathematical analysis of probe lengths
key_findings_and_limitations: Historical origin of probe-count formulas; not formally published; cited in Knuth TAOCP Vol 3.

title: Abseil C++ Library: Swiss Table Hash Maps (Design Documentation)
venue: Abseil open-source project, abseil.io
algorithms_covered: flat_hash_map; flat_hash_set; node_hash_map; node_hash_set; Swiss Table architecture
methodology: API documentation and design notes
key_findings_and_limitations: Practical reference for SwissTable design decisions; not peer-reviewed; covers load factor threshold (87.5%), SIMD usage, and iterator invalidation rules.

title: Uniform Hashing in Constant Time and Linear Space
venue: Proceedings of STOC 2003, pp. 622–628 (journal version: SIAM J. Comput., DOI 10.1137/060658400)
algorithms_covered: Uniform hashing; perfect hashing; constant-time lookup
methodology: Theoretical construction using polynomial hashing and derandomisation
key_findings_and_limitations: Achieves truly uniform hashing in O(1) time and O(n) space; theoretical result not yet practical.
